title: Pad thai
intro: Pad thai is Thailand's best-known noodle stir-fry, built on flat rice noodles tossed in a sweet-sour-salty sauce with egg, tofu and a protein of choice. Its appeal lies in the balance of flavours and textures — soft noodles, crunchy bean sprouts and peanuts, and a sauce that hits sour, salty and sweet all at once.
